modelOverview: The Tank Must XL (Extra-Large) is the largest size in Cartier's 2021 revival of the Must de Cartier line and the only one fitted with a mechanical movement: the in-house automatic Calibre 1847 MC with a date at 6 o'clock. Its 41mm x 31mm steel case carries the silvered flinqué dial, Roman numerals and blued-steel sword hands shared with the quartz models, on an interchangeable leather strap.

WSTA0040.movement: Automatic · Cartier Calibre 1847 MC · 28,800 vph · 23 jewels · ~42h power reserve
WSTA0040.materials: Stainless steel case; interchangeable black grained calfskin strap with interchangeable steel folding buckle
WSTA0040.dial: Silvered flinqué dial with black Roman numerals, blued-steel sword-shaped hands and a date aperture at 6 o'clock; beaded crown set with a synthetic cabochon-shaped spinel
WSTA0040.description: Note: Cartier lists reference WSTA0040 as the Extra-Large Tank Must rather than a Large model. It is the automatic member of the 2021 Tank Must family, housing the in-house Calibre 1847 MC with a date window beneath a silvered flinqué dial in a 41mm x 31mm steel case on a black calfskin strap. Every piece we offer is sourced and independently authenticated before sale.
